Domain constraints (NOT NULL / CHECK on domain-typed record fields) are not checked during populate. io::input applies only the base-type input routine and typmod. PG runs domain_check_safe in populate_composite.
Anonymous record types for to_record / to_recordset are resolved through ctx.env.composite_fields(result_type.oid). The binder must register the column definition list there.

Set-returning functions compute all rows eagerly and return any error from the call itself, instead of raising it mid-iteration. This is the allowed collect-then-into_iter approach. PG streams, so an error in a later element can appear after earlier rows in PG but not here. Result is the same for the caller since PG materializes these SRFs too.
Error CONTEXT lines (e.g. JSON data, line 1: ...) are omitted because PgError has no context field in contract v1.
